prompts.baita:
Use case: identity-preserve. Input is the exact RIGHT-facing neutral combat sprite. Create a DEATH collapse animation key-pose sheet of the SAME character in same outfit, same face and proportions, same right-facing battle camera. Six hand-drawn consecutive distinct full-body poses, not a rotated flat paper puppet. Square image 1536x1536. Strict TWO columns by THREE rows; SIX equally sized wide 768x512 cells, reading left-to-right row-by-row. Each complete figure and all props entirely within its own wide cell, 5% clean transparent cell margins, 90% cell-height fixed ground line. Same bodily SCALE in every pose, anatomical head/body/limb length constant; fallen horizontal body uses width of cell, MUST NOT be shrunk. Character original standing/seated height approx 75% cell height. Face/head still oriented toward SCREEN RIGHT (not toward viewer), eyes CLOSE on loss of consciousness, never face camera or swap facing. Natural gravity, body loses support, knees buckle, hand catches floor, torso contacts floor, then horizontal lying still. Empty background truly alpha=0 everywhere outside figures/props; sharp clean antialiased silhouettes, no haze/halo/smoke/floor shadows, no scenery, blood or gore, text, numbers, cell borders/dividers. All weapon tips/hair/boots included, maintain same outfit/item designs, no extra limbs, no changing size. Simplified hard-edge anime painting exactly follows reference.
Death sequence: Female seated mage: brown curls, green suspender skirt, white blouse, Mary Jane shoes, same wooden chair and gold lap book. The chair stays upright at LEFT side of each cell at same world position; mage begins seated facing RIGHT and collapses off the front of chair toward RIGHT. (1) eyes shut, torso slumps forward, hands lose strength above lap book; (2) slides forward off seat, knees buckle, closed book begins slipping down; (3) kneels on ground just in front of same upright chair, one hand braces ground, book beside knees; (4) torso sinks farther toward RIGHT, elbow bends, hips settling to floor; (5) side falls, cheek nearing floor, whole body low; (6) fully unconscious horizontal side-lying on ground to RIGHT of upright chair, head rightward, legs leftward, closed eyes, arms relaxed, full skirt and shoes visible. Two little floating books gradually lose height, end closed/on ground near chair, no glitter. Keep entire chair and full horizontal body inside every cell. Chair position/scale remain identical, body is truly lying on floor in last frame, not merely asleep in chair.
